# Signal Station (noahmenon.com)

> Free, no-sign-up study games for IB Diploma students and chess players. Scores stay in the visitor's browser.

## What's on the site
- Quiz Arcade: multiple-choice decks for IB Economics, IB Psychology and IB Biology, plus Sport Lab and Game Theory, each answer explained. New questions weekly.
- Chess Lab: a daily chess puzzle, classic checkmate patterns (back-rank, Arabian, corner knight, queen box) and a puzzle builder.
- Club Deck: builds chess-club puzzle presentations and exports them to PowerPoint in one click.
- Link-4: a daily word-connection grid (four groups of four).
- AI Lab: short interactive missions explaining AI and rating maths (such as the Elo formula) with sliders and charts, no code.
